department_name: Public Health and Family Welfare Department
department_name_hindi: लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग
headquarters: Mantralaya, Vallabh Bhawan, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh - 462004
description: The primary government body responsible for formulating and implementing health policies, maintaining healthcare infrastructure, managing public hospitals, and executing national and state-level public health programs across Madhya Pradesh.
sub_divisions: Madhya Pradesh Public Health Services Corporation Limited (MPPHSCL)
primary_functions: Planning, executing, and monitoring public health infrastructure from District Hospitals down to Sub-Centres
Implementation of Ayushman Bharat - Niramayam MP Scheme and National Health Mission programs
Procurement and distribution of essential medicines and medical equipment to government facilities
Prevention, surveillance, and control of communicable and non-communicable diseases
Maternal and child health services, including immunization and family planning initiatives
key_services_offered: Free inpatient and outpatient medical treatment at public health centers
Issuance of medical certificates, disability certificates, and birth/death certificates
Emergency ambulance dispatch and healthcare referral services
Free diagnostic tests and drug distribution under state health schemes
